parameters.formDescription: Enter the website of the company you want to analyse.

parameters.customBody:
{{
  "runMode": "PRODUCTION",
  "startUrls": [
    {
      "url": "{{ $json.page_url }}"
    }
  ],
  "linkSelector": "",
  "globs": [],
  "pseudoUrls": [],
  "excludes": [
    {
      "glob": "/**/*.{png,jpg,jpeg,gif,svg,webp,pdf,zip}"
    }
  ],
  "pageFunction": "async function pageFunction(context) { const $ = context.jQuery; $('script, style, noscript, svg, iframe').remove(); const text = (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/[ \\t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\\n\\s*\\n+/g, '\\n').trim(); const links = []; $('a[href]').each(function () { const href = this.href; const label = $(this).text().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim() || 'link'; if (href && href.indexOf('http') === 0) links.push('[' + label + '](' + href + ')'); }); return { url: context.request.url, title: $('title').first().text().trim(), text: text, markdown: text + '\\n\\nLINKS:\\n' + Array.from(new Set(links)).join('\\n') }; }",
  "injectJQuery": true,
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true
  },
  "proxyRotation": "RECOMMENDED",
  "useChrome": false,
  "headless": true,
  "ignoreSslErrors": false,
  "downloadMedia": false,
  "downloadCss": false,
  "maxRequestRetries": 2,
  "maxPagesPerCrawl": 1,
  "maxResultsPerCrawl": 1,
  "maxCrawlingDepth": 1,
  "maxConcurrency": 1,
  "pageLoadTimeoutSecs": 60,
  "pageFunctionTimeoutSecs": 60,
  "waitUntil": [
    "networkidle2"
  ],
  "closeCookieModals": true,
  "maxScrollHeightPixels": 5000,
  "debugLog": false,
  "browserLog": false
}}

parameters.query: ={{ $json.domain }} company product pricing customers about team careers
